critical_code_review_comments: routes/procurement.py is 745 lines in a single module; consider splitting Cart / Purchase Orders / Quotes / AI-reco into separate routers for maintainability.
AI-reco endpoint scans entire purchase_orders collection sorted by created_at to backfill last_unit_cost — fine for demo (~200 POs) but should be capped/indexed before scale.

_next_counter relies on find_one_and_update(upsert=True, return_document=AFTER); the fallback to a follow-up find_one is correct but the type-ignore should be removed by importing pymongo.ReturnDocument.AFTER explicitly.

submit_cart loops per supplier and awaits _next_po_number() sequentially — fine, but if two retailers submit simultaneously the per-distributor notification could double-fire; consider a single bulk notification.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (every data-testid in the review request is present and wired to the correct API)
